{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse with a V-neck and slightly ruffled sleeves, medium length falling just below the hips, deep emerald green (#043927), woven silk crepe.
Tailored wool-blend skirt with a subtle A-line silhouette and a concealed back zip, midi length hitting mid-calf, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy worsted wool.
Structured blazer featuring notched lapels, single-button closure, and two front pockets, cropped length ending at the waistline, matching charcoal gray with fine herringbone texture, virgin wool blend.
Pointed-toe pumps with a 7 cm stiletto heel and a smooth finish, classic black (#000000), patent leather.
Delicate gold-plated pendant necklace resting on the collarbone and thin bracelet on the right wrist.
This outfit works because the dark neutral palette of charcoal and green creates an elegant, sophisticated base suitable for an evening dinner. The structured blazer over the fluid silk blouse balances professional polish with feminine softness, perfectly matching the requested smart dress code. Finally, the midi skirt and pointed heels elongate the silhouette while providing enough coverage and comfort to transition smoothly from the restaurant entrance to the table."}
